name: ctrader-bridge
description: cTrader Open API -> Supabase live-P&L bridge. Read-only (scope=accounts). Replaces the cTrader cBot: no terminal, no chart, no execution risk. Writes account_live / account_live_history that the dashboard reads via /api/ctrader/live & /history.

scripts.check: node --check bridge.mjs && node --check _client.mjs && node --check _proto.mjs && node --check _oauth.mjs && node --check _supabase.mjs && node --check auth.mjs
